description:
Ideal op-amp closed-loop gain and resulting -3 dB bandwidth for inverting or non-inverting configs.

Inverting: Av = -Rf/Rin. Non-inverting: Av = 1 + Rf/Rin. Noise gain = 1 + Rf/Rin (both). Bandwidth = GBW / noise_gain.
Args: config ('inverting'|'noninverting'), rin_ohm, exactly one of rf_ohm or target_gain (magnitude), gbw_hz (optional -> bandwidth).
Returns (structured): { gain_vv (signed), gain_db, noise_gain, rf_ohm, bandwidth_hz (null if no gbw) }.
Example: non-inverting Rf=90k, Rin=10k -> +10 V/V, 20 dB; GBW 1 MHz -> 100 kHz. Snap Rf with embedcalc_eseries_nearest.

rin_ohm.description: Input resistor (inverting) or ground resistor Rg (non-inverting)

name: embedcalc_op_amp
title: Op-Amp Gain & Bandwidth
